summary.name: Neos CMS
summary.one_liner: Neos is an open source content management system and content application framework, built with PHP, that offers an inline editor and multi-site and multi-language support.
use_cases: Editing website content inline in the browser
Creating enterprise websites with role-based editing
Self-hosting a content management system on your own infrastructure
Building custom content applications on a PHP framework
summary.what_it_does: Neos is an open source CMS and content application framework written in PHP. The page highlights a True Inline Editor, where content is edited directly on the page so what you see is what you get. It supports multi-language and multi-site setups, and includes SEO tools for site performance. Enterprise features mentioned include role management and a media center. The page positions Neos for self-hosting on your own infrastructure and for implementing business-specific domains.
notable: True Inline Editor for what-you-see-is-what-you-get editing
Built-in role management and media center for enterprise use
Licensed GPL-3.0; listed on awesome-selfhosted (Neos or TYPO3 Neos for version 1)
caveats: Page does not state specific pricing for support or enterprise tiers
Page does not detail system requirements beyond PHP
